title: Routing LLM calls by task cost
body: A multi-agent orchestration pattern sends classification to a small LLM and planning to a large one. The agent layer never picks a model directly.

title: n8n as the orchestration backbone
body: Scheduled n8n workflows collect sources, call an agent over HTTP and write results to a knowledge store. Each step is observable in the execution log.

title: Exposing a knowledge base through MCP
body: An MCP server gives any agent the same search and write tools over the knowledge base, so context is shared instead of copied into prompts.

title: From SAP process to agent workflow
body: Mapping an SAP procure-to-pay process onto agent steps: each business control becomes an explicit check in the orchestration, with an LLM only where judgment is needed.

title: Idempotent ingestion for a self-updating knowledge base
body: Identity by URL, freshness by content hash. Re-running the pipeline is safe and only changed sources are rewritten.

title: Weekend sourdough schedule
body: Feed the starter Friday night, bulk ferment Saturday, bake Sunday morning.

title: Choosing a trail running shoe
body: Stack height, drop and lug depth matter more than brand.

title: Agent memory that survives restarts
body: Agents write decisions back to the knowledge base through MCP, so the next run starts from what the last one learned.
